names.source: work/glossary/reference/jigoku_glossary.json: ユーサー = Uther (official); https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Characters/Banpresto_Original_Characters_List : 'Uther Insaraum'; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2.2/Story4 uses 'Uther' throughout
names.note: Own library entry pilot 530; shared with original_1a (keep 'Uther').

names.jp: ユーサー・インサラウム
names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Characters/Banpresto_Original_Characters_List : ユーサー・インサラウム = Uther Insaraum; glossary インサラウム = Insaraum (official)
names.note: akurasu Z2.2 story pages spell the country 'Insalaum' but the glossary keeps 'Insaraum' (also the Z2.2 Mech List 'Palace Insaraum' and the SRW Glossary page).

names.jp: ライアット・ジャレンチ
names.source: https://www.hlj.com/hg-gunleon-super-robot-wars-banh674159 (Bandai HG Gunleon kit copy: 'the Riot Jarenti, approximately 23cm long') and https://newtype.us/p/DLEaEZbTkyblFX3S5TMX
names.note: Gunleon's hand-held repair tool. Licensed Bandai English is 'Riot Jarenti'; the earlier proposal 'Riot Jarrenchi' is a plain romanization. A retailer page (modelverse.co.uk) says 'Riot Gia-Wrench' but that is a paraphrase, not the kit copy.

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2/Mech_List : 'Dimensional Beast Rhino DAMON' = 次元獣ライノダモン; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2/Story ('Rhino-class', 'DAMON class: DAMON, Bull DAMON, Rhino DAMON, Dino DAMON')
names.note: akurasu writes DAMON in capitals and as two words. The prose has 'ライノダモン-class' so it reads 'Rhino DAMON-class'. Keep in step with original_1b ダモン / ディノダモン (Dino DAMON).

names.source: work/glossary/reference/sources/akurasu_z3.2_pilot_database.wiki : 'Rand Travis'; glossary ランド = Rand (confirmed)
names.note: Pilot 493 (profile in characters).

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.2/Flow_Chart : 第１５話：決戦、ラース・バビロン！ = 'Scenario 15: The Battle at Wrath Babylon!'
names.note: Imperial capital of the New Earth Empire (Central Siberian Plateau).

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2/Flow_Chart : 第22話：リモネシア強襲 = 'Scenario 22: Limonecia Assault'; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2/Story ('the small country Limonecia'); Z2 Story_Summary Parts 1, 3, 5 also 'Limonecia'
names.note: The Jigoku library English is 'Limonesia' and two earlier proposals (kw_090/kw_135/pt_496) used it. akurasu is nearly unanimous on 'Limonecia' (one Z2 Story_translation link title has 'Limonesia', the Z2 Story_Summary Part 2 has 'Limonia'). Used as 'Republic of Limonecia'.

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.2/Parts : リヴァイヴ・セル = 'Revive Cell'; Z3.2/D-Trader; Z2 Story_Summary Part 5 ('Revive Cells Gaiou's mech manufactures')
names.note: Also the name of the D-Trader item and Gaiou's conversion nanomachines; same term.

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2.2/Mech_List : 'Li-Brasta R', 'Li-Brasta L' = リ・ブラスタR/L; work/glossary/reference/sources/akurasu_z3.2_mech_list.wiki : 'Li-Brasta T'; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2.2/Story5 'Li-Brasta'
names.note: The library text uses the bare リ・ブラスタ (no T/R/L), so the token is 'Li-Brasta'. Base unit ブラスタ = Brasta (Z2.2 Mech List). Shared spelling with original_1b (ブラスタ).

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.R/Story_Summary : 'Leylines' (D-Energy supply lines Sidereal guards)
names.note: Text pluralizes with s outside the token ('レイラインs').

names.source: No wiki/official English found (searched all saved akurasu Z2/Z3 pages and the web); Latin 'lemures' (restless dead) is the evident source of the katakana
names.note: UCW DEM prototype line: 00 Lemures Prototype, 01 Lemures, 02 Chaos Lemures (カオス・レムレース is in original_1a). Alternative 'Remres' rejected.

names.jp: レーベル・ゲネラール
names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Characters/Banpresto_Original_Characters_List : レーベン・ゲネラール = 'Leben General' (Seiyuu Isshin Chiba); library keyword 136 gives the full name as レーベン・ゲネラール
names.note: レーベル is a typo in the game text itself (keyword 129 DSCR/DSC2 list 'レーベル・ゲネラール, シュラン・オペル, ツィーネ・エスピオ'); keyword 136 and the wiki have レーベン. Same person as レーベン・ゲネラール. Ask for a retoken of the keyword 129 mentions. 'General' (not 'Generar') because the wiki writes 'Leben General'; ゲネラール is the German Generale and the wiki keeps 'General'.

profile.gender_evidence: keyword 136 DSCR: 生真面目で純朴な好青年を装っていた (posed as a serious, guileless young man); hates women with one exception (エーデル), so he is a man (女性の存在を憎悪); akurasu list seiyuu Isshin Chiba
profile.position: Captain (大尉) of Chimera 1st Squad, directly under Brigadier General Edel Bernal, New Earth Federation Forces of the UCW
profile.personality: outwardly serious and earnest, actually hysterical and self-centred; hates women except Edel, for whom he would give his life; impulsive; close friend of Captain Schran Opel of the 2nd Squad

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Characters/Banpresto_Original_Characters_List : 'Leben General' (short name of レーベン・ゲネラール); library keyword 136 WORD レーベン
names.note: Short name of Leben General (Chimera 1st Squad captain).

names.jp: レーベン・ゲネラール
names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Characters/Banpresto_Original_Characters_List : レーベン・ゲネラール = 'Leben General'
names.note: Full name; profile is on レーベル・ゲネラール (same person).

names.source: jigoku_glossary.json アンナロッタ = Annalotta (official); https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Characters/Banpresto_Original_Characters_List lists her mother as 'Anna Lotta Stalls', supporting the Lotta element; no wiki entry for the daughter herself
names.note: One of the twin daughters (アンナ and ロッタ) of Gadlight and Annalotta. Needs the twin Anna spelled 'Anna' (original_1a).

profile.gender_evidence: library keyword 126 DSC2 and pilot 507 DSC2: 双子の娘 / 二人の娘 (twin daughters, named Anna and Lotta)
profile.position: infant twin daughter of Gadlight Meonsam and Annalotta Stohls (born after Annalotta's execution)

names.source: No wiki/official English found. Library keyword 56 DSCR defines it: 次元獣化（＝ヴァイオレイション）; katakana of the English word 'violation'
names.note: The process by which a mobile weapon and its pilot are converted into a Dimensional Beast. The prose uses it as a noun ('undergo Violation', 'be forced to undergo Violation into the Dino DAMON class').

names.source: No English source (akurasu names the being Dimensional General Gaioh/Gaiou only). Japanese confirmation: library keyword 91 (「ヴァイシュラバ」という真の名) and https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/バンプレストオリジナルのキャラクター一覧 (次元将としての本当の名前は「ヴァイシュラバ」)
names.note: Gaiou's true name (library keyword 91 and pilot 535). Pilot 535 (profile in characters). Alternative 'Vaishravana' is the standard Buddhist romanization, but the game's katakana ends in -バ, not -ヴァナ.

names.source: No English source found. https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/バンプレストオリジナルの機動兵器一覧 (ゲールティランこと次元獣ヴィシュラカーラ: Gaiou's unit Gale Tylan has this true name; four were built); https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2.2/Mech_List 'Gale Tylan' = ゲールティラン; library robot 317 DSCR
names.note: Gaiou's unit, known in English pages as Gale Tylan (akurasu Z2.2 Mech List); ヴィシュラカーラ is its true name, which Gaiou calls out when he becomes the Dimensional General; the Dimensional General Vildark entry says Vildark's equivalent was lost. Kept kind robot. Reading uncertain (-カーラ = kara/kala); 'Vishrakara' is a plain romanization.

names.source: work/glossary/reference/sources/akurasu_z3.2_mech_list.wiki : 'Dimensional General Vildark'; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.2/Complete_Chart ('Defeat the Dimensional General Vildark'); https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.2/D-Trader ('Have Crowe fight Vildark')
names.note: The SRW Glossary page (saved akurasu_srw_glossary.wiki) writes 'Wildark' once; the Z3.2 pages all use 'Vildark' and the mech list wins. Same person as Emperor Australis (library robot 317: 次元将としての正体を現した皇帝アウストラリスの真の姿). Pilot 522 belongs to original_1b.

names.jp: 哀しみのサクリファイ
names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Characters/Banpresto_Original_Characters_List : 哀しみのサクリファイ = 'Sadness Sacrifice' (page title only, no description); library pilot 514 DSCR: 「哀しみ」の感情を司る存在
names.note: See report.uncertain. The wiki list machine-translates the whole name emotion-first ('Sadness Sacrifice', 'Angry Doctrine', 'Fun Tempty') and does the same badly elsewhere (尸空 = 'Sky', 尸刻 = 'Engraving'). I keep the wiki's spelling of the given name (Sacrifice, with c) but use the natural 'of' order that matches the Japanese の and 'Advent of Joy'. Short forms: Sacrifice / Doctrine / Tempty (サクリファイ, ドクトリン, テンプティ are in original_1a/1b). 哀しみ is 'Sorrow' to match the user-confirmed sphere 悲しみの乙女 = Sorrowful Maiden. ja.wikipedia: appears as a green-haired goddess; Doctrine as an old man with a monocle; Tempty as a pink-haired girl.

names.source: glossary アドヴェント = Advent (official); library pilot 511 DSC2: 元は「喜び」の感情を司る存在; same 喜怒哀楽 pattern as the other three Angels
names.note: The name Advent used as the joy-Angel (library pilot 510 DSC2 reveals he is 喜びのアドヴェント). Same person as アドヴェント.

profile.gender_evidence: same being as Advent; library keyword 30 DSC2 and pilot 523 DSCR use 彼 for アドヴェント; akurasu list seiyuu Junichi Suwabe
profile.position: one of the Angels (御使い), originally governing the emotion of joy; leader of the Chrono Reformists

names.source: Literal, from 次元力 (see that entry) and 地球; no wiki entry
names.note: Library keyword 12: the dimensional power stored across the Earth, drawn from the zodiac stars.

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.2 : 天獄篇 = 'Heavenly Prison Chapter'; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3 : 時獄篇 = 'Time Prison Chapter'
names.note: Library keyword 16 DSC2: the events from the complete destruction of the Time Prison to the spacetime repair. Pairs with 時獄戦役 = Time Prison War. 'War' follows the entry's 戦争 (cf. 再世戦争 = Regeneration War).

names.source: Jigoku library English 'the Taiji'; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.2/Flow_Chart : 第３２話：太極 = 'Scenario 32: Embodiment of All Things' (paraphrase, not a name)
names.note: Reading not given in the library. The Spheres are fragments of the will of the 太極. Alternatives: 'Taikyoku' (Japanese reading; the wiki's BGM list writes 'Taikyoku' for 太極拳) or 'the Supreme Ultimate'. 'Taiji' kept as the familiar English form of 太極; low confidence.

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.2/Flow_Chart : 第２５話：特異点の使命 = 'The Mission of the Singularity'; Z2 Story ('every singularity was pulled away from their world'); 始原 = primordial
names.note: Plural 'Primordial Singularities'; the third one is Zine Espio (Queen).

names.source: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/バンプレストオリジナルのキャラクター一覧 (尸刻 ... 「しこく」と読む, Kishuku vice-captain, Shikuu's sister); https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.R/Story_Summary ('Shikuu's subordinate Shikoku')
names.note: Reading しこく (Shikoku) confirmed by ja.wikipedia. The akurasu Banpresto list page title 'Engraving' is a literal gloss of 刻 and is rejected (the same list gives 尸空 as 'Sky', which the glossary overrides with Shikuu).

profile.gender_evidence: library pilot 509 DSC2: 物静かな女性 (a quiet woman); 尸空の実妹 (Shikuu's biological younger sister); akurasu list seiyuu Umeka Shoji
profile.position: vice-captain of Kishuku, a special unit of Sidereal; pilots Shimeisou Zetsu; current head of Kishuku (per library robot 308 DSC2)
profile.personality: quiet, never shows emotion; loyal to her brother and to Kishuku's fate

names.source: work/glossary/reference/jigoku_glossary.json : 尸空 = Shikuu (official, from akurasu Z3.R Story Summary)
names.note: Same person as the pilot 尸空 (pilot 508 profile in characters); keyword 0 is his library entry.

names.source: work/glossary/reference/sources/akurasu_srw_glossary.wiki (akurasu SRW Glossary, Spheres): 'Advent improvised and created Supreme God Z out of Asakim and the Three Angels'
names.note: Eight earlier batches proposed 'Envoy' (literal 'divine messenger'); the wiki calls them Angels and 御使い is the ordinary Japanese-Bible word for angel. See report.uncertain: Eva's 使徒 is also 'Angel' in the glossary and テンシ (original_1b) is a separate term, so the wiki form can collide. Text uses a plural s outside the token. Note: a 'Z-series Angel' (エンジェル) who carries out the world-reset decision is mentioned on ja.wikipedia's terms list for the first Z game; it is not a library token, so no clash inside the Japanese.

names.source: No wiki entry; library pilot 533 DSCR: 二年に一度の御前武闘会, winner receives the title 'Gallus'
names.note: 御前 = in the sovereign's presence, 武闘会 = martial tournament. Alternative 'Royal Martial Tournament'.

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Characters/Banpresto_Original_Characters_List : 怒りのドクトリン = 'Angry Doctrine' (page title only); library pilot 512 DSCR: 「怒り」の感情を司る存在
names.note: See 哀しみのサクリファイ for the naming choice (given name 'Doctrine', 'of Anger' order).

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.2/Flow_Chart : 第１話：新地球皇国 = 'Scenario 1: New Earth Empire'
names.note: Also called the Empire (皇国) and the Gaia Empire (ガイアエンパイア, original_1a). Kept 'New Earth Empire' in full for the token.

names.source: Literal (新 new + 地球連邦軍 = Earth Federation Forces, the form used in the akurasu SRW Glossary and the Jigoku library); no wiki entry for the UCW body
names.note: Only the UCW body (library keyword 129, Chimera). gundam_1 already split the After War Gundam X use off as 新地球連邦軍#awgx = 'New UNE Forces' (retoken of pilot 121 DSCR is in their report), so this untagged token stays the Original series' Earth Federation branch. Alternative 'New Earth Federation Army' rejected: the Jigoku library and akurasu SRW Glossary both say 'Earth Federation Forces'.

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2/Story : 'the newly formed New Empire Imperium'; work/glossary/reference/jigoku_glossary.json (proposed, same form)
names.note: akurasu Z2 Story Summary mostly shortens it to 'the Imperium'.

names.source: work/glossary/reference/jigoku_glossary.json : 新日本 = New Japan (proposed); no akurasu source found; library keyword 15: the southern one of the two Japanese archipelagos, named 新日本 after the Federation reorganization
names.note: Literal and consistent with 'Neo Tokyo-2' style; no better source exists.

names.source: Literal; library keyword 49 WORD (the phenomenon seen on Mel Beater: 生物としての時間が停止している)
names.note: Entry name only (the description does not use the phrase). Alternative 'Time Has Stopped'.

names.source: User decision 時の牢獄 = Time Prison; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3 : 時獄篇 = 'Time Prison Chapter'; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.2/Flow_Chart : 時獄の果てに = 'End of the Time Prison'
names.note: 戦役 rendered 'War' (library keyword 16: the series of battles from the Neo Spacequake). Pairs with 天獄戦争 = Heavenly Prison War. The earlier 'Time's Prison War' is superseded by the user's 'Time Prison'.

names.source: work/glossary/reference/jigoku_glossary.json : 時空修復 = Spacetime Repair (proposed); base term 時空 = Spacetime (Spacequake official)
names.note: akurasu Z2 Story calls the Z1 event 'the Dimensional Mending' (Japanese not shown, probably this term). Kept the glossary form; consistent with Spacequake / Spacequake Bomb.

names.source: work/glossary/reference/jigoku_glossary.json : 時空震動弾 = Spacequake Bomb (proposed); base 時空震動 = Spacequake (official; note says Bomb variants must match)
names.note: Orguss weapon shared with the Orguss group; keep in step with their spelling.

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Characters/Banpresto_Original_Characters_List : 楽しみのテンプティ = 'Fun Tempty' (page title only); library pilot 513 DSCR: 「楽しみ」の感情を司る存在
names.note: See 哀しみのサクリファイ. 楽しみ = 'Pleasure' (the fourth of 喜怒哀楽); the wiki's 'Fun' is the alternative.

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2.2/Flow_Chart : 第45話：次元力 = 'Scenario 45: Dimension Power'; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2.2/Timeline : 'Dimensional Power'; work/glossary/reference/jigoku_glossary.json (proposed, same)
names.note: The akurasu Z3.R Story Summary writes 'Dimensional Energy' / 'D-Energy' for the same thing, and DEC is glossed 'dimension energy crystal'. Both forms exist on akurasu; I keep 'Power' (glossary form, two akurasu Z2.2 pages, and the Sphere texts). See report.uncertain.

names.source: work/glossary/reference/sources/akurasu_z3.2_mech_list.wiki : 'Dimensional General Vildark' = 次元将ヴィルダーク; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2.2/Mech_List : 'Dimensional General Gaioh' = 次元将ガイオウ; work/glossary/reference/sources/akurasu_srw_glossary.wiki ('four Dimensional Generals')
names.note: Plural 'Dimensional Generals'.

names.source: work/glossary/reference/sources/akurasu_z3.2_mech_list.wiki : 'Dimensional General Vildark'; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Characters/Banpresto_Original_Characters_List : 次元将ヴィルダーク = 'Dimensional General Vildark'
names.note: Person-token form of the robot entry 317 name; same being as Emperor Australis (library robot 317).

names.source: Literal; library keyword 72: the equatorial Pacific region of the Green Earth, sea colour green; no wiki entry (akurasu Z3.2 Flow_Chart calls scenario 5 翠の大海原 = 'Ocean of Green', a different phrase)
names.note: 残される = to be left behind. Alternative readings 'Sea of the Left Behind' / 'Remaining Sea'. ja.wikipedia (terms list, 翠の地球): the Gargantia fleet was displaced 'together with the 残されの海', so this may also be a Gargantia-world term; the Gargantia group's chosen English (if any) should match. Alternative readings 'Sea of the Left Behind' / 'Remaining Sea'.

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.R/Story_Summary : Notes: D-Energy 'alternatively known as "Origin Law"'; work/glossary/reference/jigoku_glossary.json オリジン・ロー = Origin Law (official); https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2.2/Story6 ('torrents of Origin Law')
names.note: Library robot 299 DSCR gives 源理 = 次元力. The library English translation wrote 'Power of Origin' in prose (keyword 130, robot 329, 330); the term is 'Origin Law' and those prose lines should be aligned.

names.source: work/glossary/reference/sources/akurasu_srw_glossary.wiki (akurasu SRW Glossary): 'Australis, the king of Sidereal' and 'Sphere of the Standing Archer ... Its Bearer is Australis'; 皇帝 = Emperor
names.note: Australis is wiki-official; 'Emperor' is the plain rendering of 皇帝 (the wiki calls him 'king'). Same being as Dimensional General Vildark. Pilot 521 / アウストラリス in original_1a: keep 'Australis'.

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.2/Special_Systems : 'Shinka' (all units achieve shinka in stage 57); https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.2/Flow_Chart : 第５７話：真化、その意味 = 'The True Meaning of Shinka'
names.note: akurasu keeps 真化 as 'Shinka'; 融合 = fusion. Used in library pilot 499 DSC2 (Esther mastered control of dimensional power through it).

names.source: Literal (真 true, 徒 follower); library robot 299 DSCR: 御使いに選ばれた真徒のみ; no wiki entry
names.note: Singular in the token; add s outside for the plural.

names.jp: 真次元獣ディノダモン
names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2.2/Mech_List : 'True Dimension Beast Dino DAMON' = 真次元獣ディノダモン; glossary 次元獣 = Dimensional Beast (official)
names.note: Wiki writes 'Dimension Beast'; aligned with the glossary's 'Dimensional Beast'.

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2/Story : 'the King of Destruction' (Gaiou); Jigoku library English 'the King of Destruction'; glossary 破界事変 = Destruction Incident
names.note: Gaiou's title; the akurasu Z2 Story_Summary pages write 'Lord of Destruction' but the Story page and the library agree on 'King'.

names.source: work/glossary/reference/jigoku_glossary.json : 第２新東京市 = Neo Tokyo-2 (proposed, with a note); no akurasu source
names.note: Style question: the Evangelion group's 第３新東京市 is 'Tokyo-3'. Same pattern would give 'Tokyo-2'. Kept the glossary form because its note shows a deliberate choice; see report.uncertain.

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.R/Flow_Chart : 第１話：翠の地球 = 'Scenario 1: Green Earth'; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.R/Story_Summary : 'the Green (翠) Earth'
names.note: Pairs with 蒼の地球 = Blue Earth.

names.source: glossary アドヴェント = Advent (official); 聖 = Holy, as in the 聖インサラウム王国 / 聖王 entries; no wiki entry for this form
names.note: Advent after absorbing the other three Angels and merging with Supreme God Z (pilot 511, profile in characters). Alternative 'Saint Advent'.

names.source: work/glossary/reference/sources/akurasu_srw_glossary.wiki : 'Seiohki The Insa' (housed the Sphere of the Bottomless Gourd); https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z2.2/Mech_List : 'SeiOhKi The Insa'
names.note: Other akurasu spellings: 'SeiOhKi The Insa' (Z2.2 Mech_List), 'Seiouki The Insa' (Z2.2 Flow_Chart); the glossary page wins. ジ = The.

names.source: work/glossary/reference/sources/akurasu_srw_glossary.wiki (Spheres): 'Supreme God Sol', 'Supreme God Z'
names.note: Matches 至高神Ｚ (see report.challenges).

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.R/Story_Summary : 'the Blue (蒼) Earth'
names.note: Pairs with 翠の地球 = Green Earth.

names.source: No wiki entry (akurasu only has 'Blood-stained Euphie' for an unrelated 血染め); Jigoku library English 'the Bloodstained Eye'; library keyword 1 (symptom: both eyes turn red)
names.note: Used plural because the symptom affects both eyes and the text says patients with 'Bloodstained Eyes'.

names.source: Derived from 時空修復 = Spacetime Repair (proposed) plus 超 = hyper; no wiki entry
names.note: The series titles use 超時空 = 'Super Dimension' (Super Dimension Century Orguss, akurasu-official), so 'Super Spacetime Repair' is an alternative. kw_000's plain 'hyperspacetime restoration' should become this token.

names.source: Jigoku library English 'the Shadow Moon'; no wiki entry (library keyword 91 / pilot 501: the site of the decisive battle of the Destruction Incident, i.e. a place)
names.note: Used as 'at the Shadow Moon' (a location). Reading not given. https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/バンプレストオリジナルのキャラクター一覧 says the Great Axion was believed to be at 陰月 (Aim's hiding place) and the Destruction Incident's final battle happened there; library pilot 501 says Gaiou sent Shiony 'from 陰月 to Earth'.

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.R/Story_Summary : Notes 'the manipulation of the spiritual quanta comprising all things' (霊子); https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.2/Z-Crystal : 集結する霊子 = 'Gathering Young Spirits'
names.note: Earlier batches wrote 'Spirit Particle Absorption System' and the prose (keyword 19/20) says 'spirit particles (i.e. life force)'. Only 'quanta' has wiki support; either fits if prose and token are aligned. ja.wikipedia (terms list, 血塗られた眼) explains the system as Sidereal drawing Origin Law from the Leylines and controlling it with Spiritia (スピリチア, vital force) absorbed from captured people.

names.source: Reading きしゅく given in the game text: library keyword 128 DSCR 「きしゅく」と読む and keyword 0 DSCR 鬼宿（きしゅく）; Jigoku library English 'Kishuku'

characters.gender_evidence: Alternate personality that lives in Suzune Saijou's body and shares her voice actress (柚木涼香; library ACTR; ja.wikipedia lists Ambriel as 涼音の別人格 with the same voice). Library robot 284 DSC2 calls Suzune 彼女. The underlying identity is one of The Edel Bernal's parallel selves (library DSC2; ja.wikipedia ジ・エーデルの並行存在の一人), whose gender is not stated for this self, so this is the body's/voice's gender, not a stated fact about the personality.
characters.position: second personality of Suzune Saijou (sub-pilot of Genion); one of the parallel-world selves of The Edel Bernal; seizes Suzune's body after Barbiel's Sphere Act, joins Sidereal and pilots the repaired Geminia to take Hibiki's Quarreling Twins; merges into Suzune at the end and stays an influence on her
characters.personality: free-spirited, capricious, follows no one; wants the bickering twins' Sphere to make full use of her own power; refused to merge into the collective Edel to keep her freedom; accepts defeat and merging once her existence is acknowledged by Hibiki and others
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/バンプレストオリジナルのキャラクター一覧 (西条涼音 / アムブリエル)

characters.gender_evidence: library pilot 491 DSCR: 彼女 (Asakim brought Glory Star before her); voice actress Yukiko Takaguchi (library ACTR, akurasu Banpresto list)

characters.position: Second Lieutenant (少尉) of the Earth Federation Forces' Glory Star combat-technology research squad; Sphere Reactor of the Sorrowful Maiden; pilots Virgola Glory (S); after the Spacetime Repair finalizes the Virgola as a production model
characters.personality: serious and dutiful; formerly timid and doubtful about being a soldier, grew into a positive outlook; careful, accurate piloting; likes eating sweets around town; resilient despite her Sphere's fate (sensory over-sensitivity that erodes the five senses)
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/バンプレストオリジナルの用語一覧 (乙女座: 洗礼名ハマリエル・ザ・スター)

characters.personality: low self-esteem and passive, but once she decides something she acts with surprising activeness; curious researcher; fond of Crow; her inferiority complex was amplified into hatred by the mind control (the akurasu Rengoku summary spells her name 'Kravia', the SRW Glossary 'Cravia', and original_1a uses 'Cravia')

characters.gender_evidence: library pilot 505 DSCR: 青年 (young man); ja.wikipedia カイメラ page: 謎の黒尽くめの男, first person 僕; voice actor Hikaru Midorikawa (library ACTR); akurasu Z3.2 Pilot Database 'Asakim Dowin'
characters.nickname: Cursed Wanderer (呪われし放浪者, the class of people with no world to return to; also 'drifter' 風来坊 to Rand, who calls him brother)

characters.personality: enigmatic and scheming, bound by a curse of immortality; his final wish is to die; his thoughts and feelings are human even though he is an image produced by the Shurouga system and not strictly a living being; aims to topple the Angel who cursed him; at last wishes to live as a human
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/カイメラ (アサキム・ドーウィン)
https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/バンプレストオリジナルの用語一覧 (呪われし放浪者)

characters.position: Sidereal executive; captain of Kishuku and head of its main house (former high priest of the death clan); Sphere Reactor of the Taciturn Crab; pilots Shiseiten; Sidereal's executioner of traitors; came to the Blue Earth to execute Annalotta
characters.personality: of few words, shows no emotion even in battle and does not react to provocation; his killing intent overwhelms those around him; only kills his targets; conceals anger at the Angels who bent his clan's fate and plots with Vildark; talks more around Crow, whose strong will disturbs his emptiness

https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/バンプレストオリジナルの用語一覧 (蟹座)

characters.gender_evidence: same being as Advent: library keyword 30 DSC2 and pilot 523 DSCR use 彼 for アドヴェント; ja.wikipedia: 青年; voice actor Junichi Suwabe (library ACTR)
characters.nickname: Supreme God (自ら至高神を名乗る, self-styled)
characters.position: Advent after absorbing the other three Angels and Asakim and merging with Supreme God Z (eight Spheres and four eternities); former leader of the Chrono Reformists
characters.personality: self-proclaimed god who wants to be the only survivor of the universe's collapse every 120 million years and manage a new universe from zero; knows he is the source of the collapse and pushes it on the grounds that a true god overcomes it; originally the Angel of joy, regained the other emotions by absorbing the others, so he concedes fault when defeated; earlier arrogant toward Sidereal and slightly airheaded; at the end helps repair spacetime and vanishes beyond the causal horizon with AG

characters.gender_evidence: ja.wikipedia: 哀しみのサクリファイ ... 翠の髪の女神の姿をしている (appears as a green-haired goddess). No pronoun in the library text (pilot 514 DSCR/DSC2) and no seiyuu listed; the Angels take a form, so this is the form's gender. Use she/her with care or keep gender-neutral wording where the line does not require it.
characters.position: one of the three Angels (御使い), the Angel governing sorrow; watches over Earth's humanity; branded people carrying the seed of Shinka with Stigmas; built the Time Prison to hide Earth in a dimensional cage from the other Angels; absorbed by Advent
characters.personality: deeply regrets destroying races and planets over 12,000 years and keeps mourning the lost souls; forever grieving both over species that do not achieve Shinka and over the Angels' deeds; the protectiveness was self-satisfaction, privately looking down on non-Angel life and treasuring the grieving self; remembers the brilliance of life when humanity and Asakim keep fighting and repents; wants to join hands with humanity
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/バンプレストオリジナルのキャラクター一覧 (哀しみのサクリファイ)

characters.gender_evidence: library pilot 516 DSC2: 彼が最後の戦いに赴いた際には (Elunaluna confides in him, 'he' = Dabalan); voice actor Masaya Takatsuka (akurasu Banpresto list)

characters.personality: both a bold warlord and a bold-yet-meticulous commander who terrifies the Resistance; absolutely loyal to and in love with his superior, whose approval is his greatest joy; sturdy and plain-spoken normally but jealous and womanish when Elunaluna is involved, and hostile to Rand, who interests her
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/バンプレストオリジナルのキャラクター一覧 (ダバラーン・タウ)

characters.position: vice-captain of the Chrono Reformists' action unit; Advent's right-hand man; the first victim of the awakened Shurouga Sin (ja.wikipedia: died shielding Advent from Asakim's attack in the fight at the galactic center); in peacetime an Italian-cuisine chef

sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/バンプレストオリジナルのキャラクター一覧 (コード：ブルー)

characters.gender_evidence: Queen is Ziene Espio (library pilot 526 DSC2). ja.wikipedia カイメラ: ツィーネ・エスピオ = アサキムと行動を共にしている謎の美女 ('a mysterious beauty'), first person 私; akurasu Banpresto list seiyuu Rie Saito; library pilot 506 describes provocative dress
characters.nickname: Queen (code name; not a rank: named for acting as the King's secretary)

characters.personality: mysterious; like all Chrono members attends gatherings only through an icon of her code name while staying in a separate room; at heart a dutiful soldier; players call her the most sensible of Z's original villains (ja.wikipedia)
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/カイメラ (ツィーネ・エスピオ)

characters.gender_evidence: library pilot 529 DSCR: 明るく面倒見がよく...出来る女性 (a cheerful, caring woman); library keyword 18 DSC2: 彼女; voice actress Yuri Noguchi (akurasu Banpresto list)

characters.gender_evidence: library pilot 534 DSCR: ナンバー３のシュバル・レプテールを師匠に持ち、彼のエメラルダン (his Emeraldan); pilot 532 DSCR gives his age as 46; ja.wikipedia: 武人肌の男; voice actor Takehiro Murozono (akurasu Banpresto list)

sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/バンプレストオリジナルのキャラクター一覧 (シュバル・レプテール)

characters.gender_evidence: Vaishrava is Gaiou's true name (library keyword 91 DSC2; ja.wikipedia 次元将ヴァイシュラバ = ガイオウ); ja.wikipedia: 野性味あふれる男 (a wild man); library pilot 532 DSCR uses 彼 for the King of Destruction; voice actor Rikiya Koyama (akurasu Banpresto list)
characters.nickname: King of Destruction (破界の王, the title he bore in Insaraum's world); Gaiou (the name Carlos Axion Jr. gave him, which he kept to the end)
characters.position: one of the Dimensional Generals, beings created to fight the fundamental calamity; after losing to the calamity he raises armies of Dimensional Beast warriors across the parallel worlds; in one world he lost his memory after a spacequake dropped him in the Holy Kingdom of Insaraum and became the King of Destruction; owner of Gale Tylan (Vishrakara)
characters.personality: strong sense of mission that survived his amnesia, so he seeks strong warriors and spreads battle, though he understands the value of peace; friendly and human when not fighting; doubts his own existence and mission but devotes himself to the fight and lives to the end as his soul commands; loves fast food, especially hot dogs
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/バンプレストオリジナルのキャラクター一覧 (破界の王ガイオウ)

characters.gender_evidence: library pilot 538 DSCR: これすらも彼にとってはマイナスではなく (he treats his grotesque looks as no minus); the AG persona is voiced by Daisuke Hirakawa (akurasu Banpresto list, AG). The name is a collective of same-person selves across parallel worlds.
characters.nickname: AG (the DEM Corporation agent robot persona he is forced to keep; the library says AG is short for AGENT, ja.wikipedia says 'All Gathered')
characters.position: the true identity of AG; a collective of The Edel Bernal of the parallel worlds fused to become a higher-dimensional lifeform, led by Jie Babel of the UCW and assisted by Elgan Roddick of the ADW; DEM Corporation's dimensional merchant front
characters.personality: faithful to his desires and treats others as tools (Jie's base personality), yet genuinely intent on toppling the Angels and willing to cooperate to do it; more cooperative than Jie thanks to the other selves; keeps Jie's self-deprecating tastes; finds his weird looks 'delicious' and likes being merchant AG (expressive, polite but aloof, harasses women); disappears beyond the causal horizon with Advent at the end
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/バンプレストオリジナルのキャラクター一覧 (AG)

challenges: 至高神Ｚ: glossary 'Supreme God Z / Hypsistos Z' (official, akurasu Z3.2 Mech List) should be 'Supreme God Z'. A slash form cannot go into prose; the akurasu SRW Glossary text (saved akurasu_srw_glossary.wiki, Spheres section) writes 'Supreme God Z' every time ('Advent improvised and created Supreme God Z out of Asakim and the Three Angels', 'Supreme God Sol' for 至高神ソル); 'Hypsistos' appears only in the mech-list row and is a Greek alias, not a translation of 至高神. 'Supreme God Sol' (至高神ソル) is settled to match.
retoken: robot 329 DSCR and DSC2 (2 uses each) and robot 330 DSCR and DSC2 (1 use each): $$黒い太陽$$ -> $$黒い太陽#sol$$ (Black Sun, the third of Sol's sacred treasures; en 'Black Sun'); the Japanese library has 黒い太陽 in only these two robots for Sol

pilot 451 DSCR/DSC2 and pilot 463 DSCR/DSC2: $$黒い太陽$$ (the Aquarion Black Sun that Mikage summons / Ancient AQ) -> a different tag, e.g. $$黒い太陽#aquarion$$; aquarion.json has no 黒い太陽 record yet, so the Aquarion group needs to settle it

keyword 129 DSCR and DSC2: $$レーベル・ゲネラール$$ (typo in the game text itself) may stay as is, because a 'レーベル・ゲネラール' record with the same English 'Leben General' is supplied; optionally retoken to $$レーベン・ゲネラール$$
uncertain: 御使い = 'Angel' (status official, single source): the akurasu SRW Glossary says 'the Three Angels' for Doctrine, Tempty and Sacrifice; eight batches proposed 'Envoy'. Risks: Evangelion's 使徒 is 'Angel' too (evangelion.json: 'the Eighth Angel') and テンシ is 'Tenshi' (original_1b). If the orchestrator wants no collision with Eva, 'Envoy' is the safe alternative; the token change is global either way.

Angels' full names (哀しみのサクリファイ, 怒りのドクトリン, 楽しみのテンプティ, 喜びのアドヴェント) are 'Sacrifice of Sorrow', 'Doctrine of Anger', 'Tempty of Pleasure', 'Advent of Joy' (all proposed). The wiki list (akurasu Banpresto Original Characters List) gives page titles 'Sadness Sacrifice', 'Angry Doctrine', 'Fun Tempty' (emotion first, no description, and the same list has 尸空 = 'Sky' and 尸刻 = 'Engraving'). I keep the wiki's given names (Sacrifice, Doctrine, Tempty, matching original_1a/1b) but not its word order. If 'the wiki wins' is applied literally, use the wiki forms.

次元力: kept 'Dimensional Power' (glossary; akurasu Z2.2 Flow_Chart 'Dimension Power', Z2.2 Timeline 'Dimensional Power'), but the akurasu Z3.R Story Summary (the main Tengoku-side page) writes 'Dimensional Energy' / 'D-Energy' and Z2 pages gloss DEC as 'dimension energy crystal'. Both exist on akurasu; a switch to 'Dimensional Energy' would also affect 地球の次元力.
